# LaunchGrade

> Grade your launch before the internet does. A free, zero-dependency CLI that audits any public page across 54 checks in 7 categories, then gives you the fixes that matter first.

LaunchGrade is built by [FastPress Labs](https://github.com/fastpresspages), a small open-source community for people who ship. The CLI, GitHub Action, MCP server, reports and agent skill are Apache-2.0. There is no account, no tracking and no paid tier.

## Quick start

- [Run the audit](https://github.com/fastpresspages/launchgrade#quick-start): `npx -p github:fastpresspages/launchgrade launchgrade your.site`
- [Read the README](https://github.com/fastpresspages/launchgrade/blob/main/README.md)
- [See a real report](https://fastpresspages.github.io/launchgrade/samples/youlauncher/report.html)
- [See a real before/after diff](https://fastpresspages.github.io/launchgrade/samples/youlauncher-recovery/report.html) via `--compare`
- [Request a free human audit](https://fastpresspages.github.io/launchgrade/#audit)

## What it checks

- **Conversion (25%)**: email capture, specific CTA, social proof, friction, human contact, value proposition, risk reversal.
- **Trust (15%)**: privacy, terms, about, social presence, security.txt, current copyright.
- **Technical (20%)**: HTTPS, status, speed, compression, caching, viewport, indexability, canonical, language, favicon, mixed content, analytics.
- **SEO (15%)**: title, description, one H1, heading order, image alt text, sitemap, robots, schema, internal links, text ratio.
- **Social sharing (10%)**: Open Graph, Twitter/X card, share image, image alt text.
- **Accessibility (5%)**: form labels, button names, descriptive links, landmarks, pinch zoom, skip link.
- **AI-agent readiness (10%)**: llms.txt, crawler access, AGENTS.md, Markdown negotiation, MCP/OpenAPI discovery, FAQ, semantic HTML, no-JS copy.

## For agents

- [MCP server](https://github.com/fastpresspages/launchgrade/blob/main/mcp/server.js): `grade_launch`, `get_fix_plan`, `list_checks`.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/fastpresspages/launchgrade/blob/main/skills/launchgrade/SKILL.md): install with `npx skills add fastpresspages/launchgrade`.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/fastpresspages/launchgrade/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository instructions for coding agents.
- [MCP manifest](https://fastpresspages.github.io/launchgrade/.well-known/mcp.json): local stdio transport and install command.

## Principles

Free means free. No fake metrics. Reports are files. Zero runtime dependencies. One useful tool beats ten empty landing pages.
